notes.title: The Fractured Shimmer goes to G2G Festival!
notes.content:
[h3]The Fractured Shimmer is part of G2G Festival 2024 in Jakarta, Indonesia![/h3]

If you're in the area, check out The Fractured Shimmer, along with other great indies on showcase at G2G Festival 2024!

📆 23-24 November 2024
📍The Luxus Grand Ballroom, Mall Glodok Kemayoran, Jakarta, Indonesia

See you there!
